sentences.text:
S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 238/2024
Avdhesh Sharma S/o Shri Siyaram, R/o Old Bazar, Diggi, Tehsil
Malpura District Tonk.
 ----Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Rajasthan, Through Public Prosecutor.

----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Anil Kumar Sharma For Respondent(s) : Mr. N.S. Gurjar, Pp
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anil Kumar Upman Order 16/04/2024
The instant petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 482 Cr.P.C seeking directions to the Trial Magistrate to pass an order on the protest petition filed by the petitioner.

Brief facts of the case are that an FIR no. 21/2016 was registered at Police Station Diggi, District Tonk on the basis of a written complaint submitted by the petitioner before the concerned magistrate for the offences punishable under sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 474 of IPC.
After thorough investigation, negative final report was submitted by the Investigating Agency on 22.03.2016.
Being aggrieved by the submission of negative final report, protest petition was filed by the petitioner which is still pending consideration before the concerned Magistrate.
It is submitted that petitioner and witnesses have been examined under Sections 200 and 202 Cr.P.C.

He further submits that written submission has also been submitted but still no order has [2024:RJ-JP:17668]
(2 of 2) [CRLMP-238/2024] been passed.
In these circumstances, counsel prays that learned Magistrate may be directed to pass an appropriate order in the protest petition at the earliest.

Considering the limited prayer made by learned counsel for the petitioner, this petition is disposed of with direction to the learned Trial Magistrate to pass an appropriate order in the protest petition filed by the petitioner in accordance with law, preferably within a period of two months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
(ANIL KUMAR UPMAN),J DEEPA RANI -37 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
